method_notes: All pages were read between about 16:50Z and 17:05Z on 2026-11-19; read_at times are approximate to within a few minutes.
DigiKey product and search pages were readable and are the only distributor-verified stock and price source in this file.
Mouser was not readable: four different mouser.com URLs timed out after 60 s each. Every Mouser channel is therefore null and marked 'not readable'. Whether Mouser lists a part was NOT verified.

analog.com and st.com timed out on every attempt, so Analog Devices and ST lifecycle status, datasheet revisions and longevity pages were not read. For those parts lifecycle_status is 'not stated' and the DigiKey 'part status' is given in notes as distributor data.
ti.com product pages were readable (lifecycle, datasheet revision, key specs) but showed no prices or stock without a login.

price_usd holds DigiKey unit prices at the exact 1, 10, 100 and 1,000 tiers where the page showed them; where a tier was missing the nearest lower tier that applies is used only if stated in notes, otherwise null.
DigiKey pages did not show a minimum order quantity; moq is 1 where the price table starts at 1 (cut tape or single unit) and is the reel quantity where only a reel tier was offered.
DigiKey pages showed an empty Environmental and Export Classifications section, so RoHS/REACH is null unless read on a manufacturer page.
key_specs entries ending '(not read today)' come from general datasheet knowledge or from the two local project files and were not re-read on a primary page today.

General practice to verify by sample: brass, titanium, nylon or PEEK screws in place of steel; gold-over-copper or non-magnetic (nickel-free) connector plating; resistors and capacitors ordered in the makers' non-magnetic termination grades, since standard chip terminations carry a nickel barrier; spring pins and shield cans checked individually.
